contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB[C] ; R/ [GLORIA EX]ERCITVS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust diademed with twin fillet cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB[C]. Reverse description: Two soldiers standing with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EX]ERCITVS. In exergue: TRP for first officina of Trier mint. Diameter: 16.3mm, Weight: 1.51gms, die axis: 12
